The test image shows:
- A tomato stem cut/peeled open, lying on black plastic mulch
- Extensive brown vascular discoloration running along the length of the stem
- Collapsed/wilted plant with dead leaves visible
- Classic internal vascular browning pattern

This points to a vascular wilt disease. Top candidates: Bacterial_Wilt, Verticillium_Wilt, Southern_Bacterial_Wilt, Bacterial_Canker_And_Wilt_Of_Tomato.

Now viewing one reference from each top candidate:

This Bacterial_Wilt reference (Bugwood 5606063) is nearly identical in source numbering to the test image (5606057) — same photo series. The brown vascular discoloration pattern matches closely.

Let me check one reference from each remaining candidate:
Verticillium Wilt shows leaf wilting — doesn't match the stem cross-section with internal vascular browning. Now checking Southern_Bacterial_Wilt:
Southern Bacterial Wilt also shows ooze test but different setup. Checking Bacterial_Canker for the 4th view:

**Analysis summary:**

- **Test image**: Tomato stem peeled open longitudinally showing extensive brown vascular discoloration along the vascular bundles; plant fully collapsed on black plastic mulch; dead leaves visible. Classic internal vascular browning.

- **Bacterial_Wilt ref (5606063)**: Shows stem cross-section with bacterial ooze in water — identical brown vascular discoloration. Bugwood ID 5606063 vs test image 5606057 = adjacent IDs from the same submission series. Very strong match.

- **Verticillium_Wilt ref (5606148)**: Shows leaf wilting only, no stem cross-section. Doesn't match.

- **Southern_Bacterial_Wilt ref (5593855)**: Also shows ooze test but different ID series and different setup.

- **Bacterial_Canker ref (5606085)**: Shows leaf margin necrosis, not vascular stem browning. Doesn't match.

The combination of (1) internal vascular browning pattern, (2) complete plant collapse, (3) Bugwood ID proximity to Bacterial_Wilt series, and (4) the stem presentation being the classic diagnostic for Ralstonia solanacearum all point clearly to Bacterial_Wilt.
